description: Search Console queries of 8 or more words for one of the user's sites (paid plans, Search Console connected): full questions, the same ones people ask ChatGPT. Returns each question with impressions, clicks, CTR, average position, question kind and the page that ranks, and 'targets': the pages that rank at position 20 or better with low CTR, each with the questions to answer in a short block at the top of that page. Read-only.

min_words.description: Default 8. Use 6 for a new site with little data.

name: get_long_questions
title: Find long questions people search
